Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Added External Input Mode: broadcast your own hardware mixer or mixing software instead of the decks
You won't hear it echoed back locally - monitor through your own gear as normal
Listeners just see "Live Input", not your specific device
